raw_segments.text: Opposite Ruggie O'Donohoe's master Patrick Aloisius Dignam, pawing the pound and a half
of Mangan's, late Farron Box, pork steaks he had been sent for, went along warm Wicklow
It was two blooming dolls sitting in the parlor with Mrs. Stower and Mrs. Quigley and Mrs.
Mac Dowell and the blind down, and they all at their sniffles and sipping subs of the
superior Tawny Sherry Uncle Barney brought from Tunnies.
And they eating crumbs of the cottage fruitcake, jawing the whole blooming time and sighing.
This is the end of this video.
